in_marathi.name: Babuna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Father of Waters
in_marathi.long_meaning: Babuna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Babuna is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Babhu' meaning father and 'Nadi' meaning water or river. This name is often given to children born near a body of water or to those who are believed to bring good luck and abundance to their families.
